body: Moved from docs/tasks/P1-instant-play-and-worst-bugs.md on 6 Nov 2026 (the task files hold the definition only; how far a task is lives on the board). **Status 2026-10-22: app part done, server part open.** Levelling now only turns loud songs down by default (the loudness enhancer is off: `ReplayGainSettings.allowBoost`, setting "Quiet places" is the only boost; the preamp slider is gone), so the phone's volume buttons are the one volume; engine tests prove the player volume is exactly 1 with levelling off through play/next/previous/seek/pause/failure and that the levelled volume comes back after a sleep-timer fade. Open: measuring loudness on the server when a file is kept (ReplayGain tags), YouTube-reported loudness for streams, the 20-song loudness measurement, and asking the owner which slider he meant.
